sections.text: Introduction

This document lists equipment inspection checklist 
I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated by eng Samir Ayad from Sabtia 1, 220kv Substation. 
This 
document was updated at 12 Jan 2002 after the 1st approval date 8
May 2000 by adding some drawings and some necessary reference data.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Ensure
that the CB isolated completely and grounded on both sides,

Safety fence 
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses
Change Remote position to be at local

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Read 
and record SF6 
pressure on manometer. (7 Bar)

Check air
pressure on manometer. (10 Bar)

Check for gas
and air leaks.
Shut off air valves at control cubicle.

Drain compressed air 
receiver.
Check tightness of screw and pipe couplings.

Check
refilling valve function: opened and closed 
and tightness. (Refilling valve 
373 (Y0) figure1)

Open 
air valves at control cubicle.

Fill the 
compressed air receiver to 10 bar

Carry out test switching 
operations,

Change
local 
position to be at
Remote.
